triage.fix_rationale: Both are transitive, so refreshing them in package-lock.json (npm audit fix) bumps them to patched versions. If the fix is not picked up automatically, add an overrides entry in package.json.
triage.hypothesis: npm audit at high level fails on two transitive packages with published advisories: browserslist (<=4.28.6) and fast-uri (3.0.0-3.1.5). The lockfile on this Dependabot Angular branch still resolves to the vulnerable versions; npm reports a fix is available.
